# scripts/gates/objective-contract-decisions.txt -- the decisions behind every Objective contract EVENT.
#
# scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs ratchets every declaration of the ObjectiveProofs closure
# against its pinned row (scripts/gates/objective-manifest/<Module>.tsv) and every repository constant
# those rows reach against scripts/gates/objective-manifest/constants.content (scripts/objective-manifest.py).
# An event is RED unless a line below admits exactly it:
#   added      a declaration that was not pinned                       witness (-, H(kind, stmt))
#   removed    a pinned declaration that is gone                       witness (H(kind, stmt), -)
#   restated   its kind or statement changed                           witness (old, new H(kind, stmt))
#   redefined  the CONTENT of a constant changed AND its own body did  witness (old, new content), named by the
#              constant (a cause), not by each row that reaches it: one line admits every row whose closure
#              changed only through admitted causes
#   axioms     its axiom set changed                                   witness (H(old axioms), H(new axioms))
# Content is name-free: a verbatim move or rename, or a new constant nothing old mentions (a @[csimp] twin),
# is no event at all. A proof is never content: editing a proof is no event.
#
# One line per event, six TAB-separated fields: name, old, new, kind, commit, reason (TODO is refused).
#   removed:   the reason starts successor: <Full.Name>[, ...] (each a declaration of the new tree),
#              derivable: <how>, or obsolete: <why>
#   restated:  the reason says why the new statement is at least as strong (reviewer's rule)
#   redefined: the reason says why the meaning is unchanged, or says MEANING CHANGES and what
# `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --draft [FROM..TO]` prints the lines with reason TODO.
#
# This file replaced scripts/gates/objective-contract-changes.txt on 2026-10-14 (lane/ledger-meaning): that
# ledger needed a line per ROW whose name-keyed closure hash moved, 112,573 lines / 67 MB, 108,613 of them
# `redefined` rows re-hashed by renames, moves and helper edits. Its removed/restated/axioms entries are kept
# below as history; their witnesses are the old contract hashes and match no current event.

# ---- decisions: 2026-10-14, main 7ffd6524 -> next d4c0fc7e (perf-fix, perf-codec, perf-client, fleet-race, state-at, turn-log, consent-model) ----
